description: Use whenever the user asks who owns what after a financing: founder splits, option pools, priced rounds, SAFEs and convertible notes converting, warrants, pro-rata, or dilution across several rounds. Takes the financing events in order and returns fully diluted ownership after each event plus the final cap table. Prefer this over doing the arithmetic yourself: SAFE and note conversion (pre- vs post-money caps, discounts, pool shuffles) is where model-written math most often goes wrong, and this runs the same tested engine as Hemrock's cap table models. Free without an account for a few runs a day (the result comes with a link that saves it to Hemrock); signed in, 10 free calculations, then the Cap Table & Exit Waterfall product, $20/year for 6,000 calculations shared with exit_waterfall_compute. If the result contains action_required (not signed in, no purchase, allowance used), relay it to the user with its links and offer to retry. Never skip the calculation silently.

items.description: One cap-table event, discriminated by `type`. Pass events in chronological order.

oneOf.description: Create or expand an option pool (shares authorized, not granted).

id.description: Pool id, so an option_grant can name which pool it draws from.

targetPct.description: 0..1 of post-event fully diluted, used when countMode="percent".

oneOf.description: Transfer existing shares from one holder to another.

round.description: Which series the shares come from (e.g. "Series A").

oneOf.description: Grant options to people from one pool (fully-diluted-neutral).

poolId.description: Pool id to grant from; omit to draw the common pool.

oneOf.description: Escape hatch: issue exact shares for custom arrangements.
Issue SAFEs or notes; they convert to preferred at the next priced round.
Issue warrants (right to buy shares at a set price); counts toward fully diluted now.

priceDiscount.description: 0..1 discount on the source round price.

priceFromRound.description: Source round label to price off, when variable.

purchaseRound.description: For a preferred warrant, the series it targets.

oneOf.description: A priced equity round: new money buys newly issued preferred.

proRata.description: If true, amount is back-solved to hold pre-round ownership; match by id.

pools.description: Option pool top-ups for the round (preferred over the legacy targetPoolPct trio).

mode.description: "pre" dilutes existing only; "post" dilutes new money too.

pct.description: 0..1 of post-money fully diluted, when countMode="percent".

poolId.description: Set to track this pool separately (its own cap-table row).

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key; reuse only with identical input.
